name: Deploy .NET 9 to Azure App Service

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - test
      - dev

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    # 1. Scarica il codice sorgente dal repository
    - name: Checkout Source Code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    # 2. Configura l'SDK di .NET 9 sulla macchina di build di GitHub
    - name: Setup .NET SDK
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
      with:
        dotnet-version: '9.0.x'

    # 3. Ripristina i pacchetti NuGet
    - name: Restore Dependencies
      run: dotnet restore

    # 4. Compila e pubblica il progetto come "Self-Contained" per Linux x64
    # Questo include l'intero motore di runtime .NET 9 nel pacchetto isolandolo dal server
    - name: Dotnet Publish (Self-Contained)
      run: |
        dotnet publish IlMioProgetto.Api/IlMioProgetto.Api.csproj \
          -c Release \
          -r linux-x64 \
          --self-contained true \
          -o ./publish

    # 5. Riconosce il branch attuale e imposta dinamicamente i nomi delle App e dei Segreti
    - name: Set Environment Variables based on Branch
      id: set-env
      run: |
        if [ "${{ github.ref_name }}" = "main" ]; then
          echo "APP_NAME=app-myproject-prod-2561" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "PUBLISH_SECRET=${{ secrets.AZURE_WEBAPP_PUBLISH_PROFILE_PROD }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        elif [ "${{ github.ref_name }}" = "test" ]; then
          echo "APP_NAME=app-myproject-test-2561" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "PUBLISH_SECRET=${{ secrets.AZURE_WEBAPP_PUBLISH_PROFILE_TEST }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        else
          echo "APP_NAME=app-myproject-dev-2561" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "PUBLISH_SECRET=${{ secrets.AZURE_WEBAPP_PUBLISH_PROFILE_DEV }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        fi

    # 6. Esegue il deployment fisico dei file estratti sulla Web App corretta su Azure
    - name: Deploy to Azure Web App
      uses: azure/webapps-deploy@v3
      with:
        app-name: ${{ env.APP_NAME }}
        publish-profile: ${{ env.PUBLISH_SECRET }}
        package: ./publish
